newsitem.title: ITALY: Optimism grows over Italian economy - Isco.
newsitem.headline: Optimism grows over Italian economy - Isco.

text.p: Italian industry saw a jump in orders in June with companies reporting growing optimism for the months ahead, state-funded economic research institute Isco said in a regular survey.
"In June, companies saw a significant improvement in orders, thanks largely to a recovery in internal demand," Isco said.
Looking to the future, Isco said firms expected price pressure to start to increase over the next three or four months, especially for intermediate goods.

But it said companies expected a general improvement both in orders and production over the same period. "The forecasts concerning the performance of the economy, shows an important improvement in optimism," the report said.
Official data released earlier this month showed Italian industrial production falling an unadjusted 1.0 percent year-on-year in May.
